mapper.update: /* updateBulkQuotationSamePrice */ UPDATE KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ SET STATUS = 'S1', AGENT_DESCRIPTION = #{DESCRIPTION}, AGENT_SPECIFICATION = #{SPECIFICATION}, AGENT_MAKER_PART_NO = #{MAKER_PART_NO}, AGENT_MAKER_CODE = #{MAKER_NAME}, AGENT_MIN_ORDER_QTY = #{MIN_ORDER_QTY}, AGENT_PUR_UNIT_QTY = #{PUR_UNIT_QTY}, AGENT_UNIT_MEASURE = #{UNIT_MEASURE}, AGENT_PROCESS_TYPE = #{PROCESS_TYPE}, AGENT_PARCEL_YN = #{PARCEL_YN}, ITEM_TYPE = 'B', MAINTAIN_PRICE_YN = 'Y', CH_LIST_PRICE = #{RE_LIST_PRICE}, PRICE_SUBMIT_USER = #{USER_ID}, STOA_DATE = SYSDATE, BUY_CLOSE_DATE = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,12),'YYYYMMDD'), DELIVERY_LT = (SELECT DELIVERY_LT FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = NVL(RFQ.BUYER, RFQ.BYIT_COMORG_CODE) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = F_SPLIT(ITEM_KEY_ID, '||', 2)) WHERE BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no} AND BURQ_RFQ_NO = #{BURQ_RFQ_NO} AND AGENT_TYPE = 'B'
